facts.fact: NITA-U reports that on 1 December 2025 the President launched the extension of National Backbone Infrastructure Phase 5 in Kanungu District, which is to connect the district headquarters and sub-counties to the backbone for the first time and is expected to connect 20 agencies there, Kanungu Town Council among them; the connections are stated as expected, not as live.
facts.system: NBI Phase 5 last-mile connectivity, Kanungu District

facts.fact: The extension of the backbone to district and sub-county offices in Kanungu is run by NITA-U, a statutory body under the Ministry of ICT and National Guidance, with that Ministry and the Office of the President, as launched on 1 December 2025.

NITA-U states that NBI Phase 5, launched nationally in Moroto on 4 December 2024, prioritises 63 districts and provides for over 5,000 km of new fibre, 21 solar-powered transmission sites and connectivity to 2,800 last-mile public institutions countrywide, local government being one of the sectors named.

systems.owner: NITA-U, with the Ministry of ICT and National Guidance and the Office of the President
systems.tiers: 63 districts; 2,800 last-mile public institutions planned, including district headquarters, sub-county offices, town councils, schools, health facilities and police posts
